note: ★ THE HONEST BASELINE — and it REFUTES the published one. `evals/README.md` claimed 9/11 with 'Zero junk'. MEASURED with the instrument: 7/11, and TWO forbidden names. The published number was produced by hand and was never reproducible; this one is a recording anyone can re-grade offline.

diagnosis.headline: THE DOMINANT FAILURE IS `source_span` — MECHANICAL, NOT RECALL. DF-064-4 is filed as an under-extraction/recall gap. The instrument says otherwise: of 13 failing runs, 10 are MECHANICAL (span/slug) and only ONE is a census drop.
diagnosis.root_cause: The SKILL asks a LANGUAGE MODEL to do ARITHMETIC ON LINE NUMBERS (`source_span: L21-L21`, 1-indexed from the file's first line, frontmatter included). It gets that wrong 29% of the time — off-by-3 on fixture 01 (miscounted frontmatter), off-by-1 on 03, and outright hallucinated (L407 where the truth is L34). Meanwhile the `source_quote` — which the rail ALREADY forces to be VERBATIM — is correct 100% of the time. THE SPAN IS A COMPUTATION, NOT A JUDGEMENT.
diagnosis.fix: `apply` DERIVES `source_span` from `source_quote` (body.index(quote) -> line range). The model is not asked for it at all. Deterministic, zero-guess, and it removes the single largest failure class.
